note: A centre for every upazila, used to place a place with no known location (shown as "আনুমানিক অবস্থান"). From OpenStreetMap admin_level=6 boundaries: the boundary's admin_centre node when it lies inside, else the polygon's centroid, else a point inside the polygon. Upazilas with no OSM boundary use the BBS/HDX centre in data/locations.json where it has one; the rest are listed under "missing" and in docs/DATA_GAPS.md. No centre is guessed.
